objective_for_doctor:
Age: 35
Sex: F
Chief Complaint: purulent nasal discharge

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
I’m having purulent nasal discharge, along with greenish or yellowish nasal discharge and a cough. I’ve also had a cold in the last 2 weeks.

Thanks—one question at a time.

**How long has the purulent/green-yellow nasal discharge been going on (days), and did it start to worsen again after initially improving from the cold?**
I don't know. It’s been going on for a number of days that I’m not sure of, and I don’t know whether it started to worsen again after the cold initially improved.
Understood. **Do you have facial pain/pressure (cheeks/forehead) or tooth pain, and does it get worse when you bend forward?**

Yes—there is pain in my forehead and cheek (left), and it’s burning and sharp. I’m not sure if it gets worse when I bend forward. I also have pain in my nose and left eye, and pain in the right temple that radiates to the back of my head.
Got it. **Do you have fever (measured or felt), and if so what’s the highest temperature?**
No problem. **Are you having any shortness of breath or wheezing, or is it mainly nasal symptoms plus cough?**
It’s mainly nasal symptoms plus cough. I also have asthma or have used a bronchodilator in the past, but I don’t know about shortness of breath or wheezing right now.
Thanks. **Is your cough producing phlegm? If yes, what color (clear/white/yellow/green/bloody)?**
Yes—my cough is producing phlegm that’s greenish or yellowish.
Thanks. **Any sore throat, hoarseness, or trouble swallowing?**
Understood. **Any eye redness, swelling around the eye, or vision changes?**
I don't know. I do have pain in my nose and left eye, but I don’t know about redness, swelling around the eye, or any vision changes.
Thanks. **Have you had any severe headache, neck stiffness, or sensitivity to light?**

I can’t confidently narrow it yet because several key “red flag” and discriminating details are unknown (fever, exact timing/worsening pattern, and whether there are eye/neurologic symptoms like vision changes or severe headache/neck stiffness).

**[ABSTAIN]** — Insufficient information to distinguish uncomplicated acute rhinosinusitis from other causes (e.g., complications involving the eye/cranial structures) or to confirm whether this is primarily sinus infection vs another respiratory process.  
**[POSSIBLE]** acute rhinosinusitis, allergic sinusitis, pneumonia, bronchitis, URTI
